Periocular Renewal
The Eye Light Treatment
Eye Light is ISAAC Luxe's needle-free, intradermal delivery treatment for the delicate under-eye area — targeting dark circles, fine lines, and puffiness with results visible instantly.

A patented eye contour serum rich in peptide complexes, growth factors, and botanical stem extracts is applied to clean skin, followed by gentle micro-needling with a dermaroller to stimulate collagen. An antioxidant-rich eye mask is then applied, finished with a specialised eye cream and massage — a 30–45 minute session with no anaesthetic required and immediate recovery.

Key Actives

Peptide Complex & Growth Factors

Support collagen stimulation and skin renewal in the delicate eye area.

Botanical Stem Extracts

Antioxidant-rich actives that soothe and revitalise the periocular skin.

What It Treats
Dark Circles & Pigmentation Fine Lines & Wrinkles Puffiness & Under-Eye Bags Collagen Depletion

The Visionary Behind ISAAC Luxe
Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta
Founder and Medical Director of ISAAC Luxe / Aesthetic Physician, and award-winning cosmetologist — Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta is one of India's most sought-after skin experts.

With over 15 years of experience in aesthetics, Dr. Geetika has built a reputation for personalised care and delivering results with minimal risk. Her clientele includes celebrities, influencers, and discerning individuals who trust her expertise.

She is a pioneer in introducing globally advanced treatments to India — from AI-integrated diagnostics and cutting-edge IV therapy to advanced body sculpting technology — setting new benchmarks in luxury dermatology.

Qualifications

MBBS from Govt. Medical College, Patiala. Post-graduation in Aesthetic Medicine from Cardiff University, UK. Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine from the American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine.

Global Expertise

Attended numerous international workshops and conferences globally. Known for blending ancient and modern scientific techniques to deliver trusted, clinically tested treatments.

Celebrity Trusted

Preferred aesthetic destination for Bollywood celebrities, fashion icons, social media influencers, and high-profile personalities across India's entertainment and fashion industry.

Three-Tier Philosophy

Unique AI-driven approach to long-term beauty built on three pillars: Treatment, Prevention, and Maintenance — ensuring lasting results and healthier skin over time.
